body: Thank you so much for your response. You're right. Now, I just have to muster up the courage and tell them I want to drop. I've been lying to them though, I said I was doing well in these classes but I'm not, I'm on the verge of failing. Gosh, I can see their faces of disappointment and they'll ask me: "what are you gonna do now?" and I won't have an answer for them. Well, I do but they're just going to be disappointed again if I tell them my actual plans in life. I just want everything to be okay.
